warning.titlePre: Land Rover Discovery TDV8 Timing Chain & Injector Wear
paragraphs: Discovery TDV8 engines — across both D3 and D4 generations — commonly show timing chain tensioner wear, injector seal leaks, and crankshaft bearing failure risk, in line with the wider TDV6/SDV6 family pattern that affects this engine family. We replace timing chain components, injector seals, EGR components, turbo components, and gaskets as standard on every TDV8 rebuild.

*include_in_hero_hook: yes — Source: same timing chain/injector pattern as TDV6/SDV6 family, widely documented, multiple TSBs and specialist sources per G-BRF. Pattern-inferred from sibling engine, same family.*
